title: Santa Airdrop
body:
"🎅Ho-ho-ho! I come with gifts for all!"

Description

Santa Airdrop is an exclusive Christmas event that happens at variable periods, behaving similar to Meteor Crashes. When the alert above appears, Santa's Sleigh spawns in the sky for a moment to fly, then drops a present straight down containing Christmas-exclusive items. These locations are not the same as known meteor crash locations. When searching for an airdrop, it's important to note that Rudolph's red nose is visible through walls, appearing as a red marker.

Known Drops

  • Gift of a Ruler
  • Gift of Musical Enjoyment
  • Gift of Sliding Snow
  • Gift of Everlasting Radiance and Unreasonably Benevolent Sparkles Beyond the Comprehension of Mortal Minds
  • Gift of Electric Humming
  • Father Grudgemas (Only 1 spawns, uncommon)
  • Grudgdeer (Only 1 spawns)
  • Candy Cane
  • Hot Cocoa
  • Christmas Wreath
  • Santa's Bag
  • Silver Sleigh Bell
  • Golden Sleigh Bell (uncommon)
